AUTOMATED JOB DISCOVERY

Find matching roles.

The hosted worker searches the employer career boards you configure. It runs on the server when scheduled.

SUPPORTED PUBLIC CAREER BOARDS

Greenhouse · Lever · Ashby

Configure employer board slugs below. Search results include match reasons and any available sponsorship evidence. Past filings are a signal, never a guarantee for a specific role.

Employer career board

one-time per company

Use the company board identifier from its career page URL. The service searches public postings and does not sign in or apply.

Sponsorship history

optional evidence CSV

Import employer-level historical filings to improve the sponsorship signal. This does not prove a role will sponsor, and does not replace checking the posting or asking the employer.

Required CSV headers: company_name,evidence_url,evidence_year,filing_count. Supports a normalized export from official DOL disclosure data.

Browser RPA assistant

navigate, then fill

Use the Neural Ant Chrome extension to open an employer application link and fill supported empty fields from your saved profile. It stops before work-authorization questions and submission.

  1. Open a job posting from a matching role below.
  2. In the extension, choose Find application links, select the correct employer link, then choose Open selected application.
  3. On the application page, choose Fill this application. Review every answer, attach your resume, complete attestations, and submit yourself.

Install or reload the unpacked extension folder in chrome://extensions. Keep Neural Ant running locally. It does not apply or transmit form entries.
